The '''Grand Kessel River Valley''' was a rock formation on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. [[Trioculus]] once disciplined a rebellious settlement in the Valley by firing a [[C-136]] "Grandfather Gun" into a river dam. The entire settlement flooded, drowning the rebels.

==Behind the scenes==
The presence of a river valley on arid Kessel, where most surface water simply sublimes into vapor, seems impossible. However, the exact nature of Kesselian ecology is indeterminate. (See:'' [[Kessel/Legends#Behind_the_Scenes|Kessel: Behind the scenes]]'').
